notes.title: Dodge the Wall update v0.2.0 released
notes.notes:
Here's what's happening in the latest release of Dodge the Wall!

[list]
[*] By popular demand, music has been added to the game! Jam to the beat as you dodge those walls. The music can be toggled from the main menu at the start of the game. 
[/list]

Have any suggestions for walls you want to see in the game? Post a reply here, or let us know over at our [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DodgeTheWall/]subreddit[/url]!

notes.title: Dodge the Wall update v0.1.1 released
notes.notes:
Our latest update to Dodge the Wall has released! 

Latest Updates: 

[list]
[*] The biggest feature in this release is a new system of increasing difficulty. As you dodge more walls, the speed of the game picks up. 
[*] More walls have been added! 
[/list]

Let us know if you have any feedback, either here in the Steam Community or over at our subreddit at www.reddit.com/r/DodgeTheWall
